fusions.name: Scent Nip
fusions.desc: A nip that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Raised Alarm
fusions.desc: You bark the alarm at every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage. If it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: On Guard
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Faithful Sentry
fusions.desc: A bonded watchhound fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds; each enemy it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
